added.summary: An earned star is drawn filled in the style's star gold under a lit edge, with a soft glow; an unearned star is a faint outline over a dim well. Each star keeps its star icon, as the well under the glyph. New parts star-rating.star and star-rating.glyph, and the --star-* role tokens, let a style pack recolour both. The landing animation is unchanged.
